subject: Deal gating: anchoring capacity with staggered OEM quote milestones
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>
To: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwoodinference.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-11-22T08:12:00-08:00
Subject: Capacity ask: ACME deal gating and quote requests

Markus / Neha —

ACME is asking for a firm onramp plan tied to their commercial close. High level numbers: they expect an initial commitment of ~400 A100-equivalent slots by 2027-02-15, with a target of 1.2k by end of Q2 for production traffic. They want visibility on delivery cadence and fallbacks before signing.

Can we get OEM lead time ballparks and whether OEMs can do staggered shipments (e.g., 50% / 30% / 20%)? Also please loop in Orbit Cloud for a short-term reserved-burst option as a backstop for Feb — we may need ~120 slots for the first 6–8 weeks.

I've attached the demand forecast and the ACME SOW snippet.

Attachments: ACME_capacity_forecast_v1.xlsx (spreadsheet)

Thanks,
Ben
Ben Carter
Director, Strategic Accounts | Redwood Inference

From: Javier Sanchez <j.sanchez@fastoem.com>
To: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-11-22T10:05:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Capacity ask: ACME deal gating and quote requests

Markus / Ben —

Thanks for the forecast. Quick summary from FastOEM: current lead time estimate for the quoted A100-equivalent assemblies is 18–22 weeks from PO receipt. We can split deliveries into tranches; minimum tranche is 20% of the total order due to shipping constraints and test cycles. Pricing in the attached PDF reflects the staggered tranche option and a firming uplift for guaranteed delivery windows.

Key constraints:
- Lead times fluctuate +/- 2 weeks depending on component supply and carrier windows.
- For a binding date we require a signed PO with a milestone schedule and a 30% deposit to reserve BOM and test slots.
- Partial shipments carry a 1.5% per-tranche logistics surcharge.

See attached: OEM_Quote_FastOEM_v2.pdf

From: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwoodinference.com>
To: Javier Sanchez <j.sanchez@fastoem.com>, sales@orbitcloud.com
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwoodinference.com>, Olga Petrov <olga_petrov@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-11-22T13:40:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Deal gating: anchoring capacity with staggered OEM quote milestones

Javier / Orbit team —

Thanks for the quick turnaround, Javier. The lead time cadence is roughly in line with what we expected, but ACME needs stronger contractual certainty (they will not sign without a clear delivery ladder + fallback). To move this forward we need three things from OEM and cloud:

1) A binding tranche schedule with milestone dates (not just weeks from PO). We propose a staggered delivery (50% initial, 30% second, 20% final) with concrete week-of delivery windows.
2) Clear terms on deposits, penalties for missed milestones, and whether OEM will put BOM allocations into a reservation/escrow. If FastOEM can commit to BOM reservation for the first tranche on receipt of a deposit that materially reduces downstream risk.
3) Orbit Cloud short-term reserved burst quote to cover the Feb ramp for ~120 A100-equivalent slots for 6–8 weeks, with an option to extend into March on a pay-as-you-go uplift.

Attached is a proposed schedule template (proposed_schedule_staggered.xlsx) — use it to map concrete dates so we can include them in the ACME mutual action plan.

We intend to present a bundled approach to ACME: OEM-stagger + cloud-backstop + a single MSA amendment that defines milestone SLAs and refunds for missed delivery windows. Please confirm the following by EOD Monday:
- FastOEM: can you provide firm week-of delivery windows per tranche and confirm escrow/reservation terms?
- Orbit: can you provide a reserved-burst SKU and pricing for the Feb window, with a 24–48 hour scale-up SLA?

Marking owners for the above so the ACME procurement conversation can proceed without us having to redline repeatedly.

Thanks,
Markus Klein
Head of Capacity Planning | Redwood Inference

From: Orbit Cloud Sales <sales@orbitcloud.com>
To: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-11-23T09:15:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Deal gating: anchoring capacity with staggered OEM quote milestones

Markus —

Appreciate the context. We can provide a reserved-burst package for Feb: 120 A100-equivalent slots for up to 8 weeks. Pricing attached. A few notes:

- To lock that capacity we need a signed short-term usage addendum and a one-time reservation fee (outlined in the attached XLSX).
- We can commit to a 24–48 hour scale-up for up to an additional 200 slots subject to availability at order time; that will be priced as an on-demand uplift.
- SLA: we offer best-effort availability for burst reservations; for contractual availability guarantees we recommend a Dedicated Reserve (longer-term commitment).

Attachments: OrbitCloud_capacity_offer.xlsx

Questions for ACME go-live plan: will ACME accept a temporary cloud-backstop (explicitly listed in the MSA) that transitions to hardware as tranches arrive? If yes, we can draft an addendum.

Best,
Jordan Blake
Head of Partnerships, Orbit Cloud

From: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwoodinference.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwoodinference.com>, Olga Petrov <olga_petrov@redwoodinference.com>

Date: 2026-11-23T16:45:00-08:00
Subject: Deal gating: anchoring capacity with staggered OEM quote milestones — summary & next steps

Team / Partners —

Summary and decisions to drive ACME to signature:

- FastOEM: provisional lead time 18–22 weeks. Action: provide firm "week-of" windows per tranche and confirm BOM reservation terms by 2026-11-30. Owner: Javier Sanchez (FastOEM).
- Orbit Cloud: reserved-burst quote received. Action: supply short-term addendum draft and reservation fee terms by 2026-11-29. Owner: Jordan Blake (Orbit).
- Redwood legal / deals: update the MSA addendum to include temporary cloud-backstop language and tranche milestone refunds. Action: draft by 2026-12-02. Owner: Olga Petrov.
- Commercial: finalize ACME mutual action plan with dates and attach OEM tranche schedule. Action: complete document and send to ACME procurement by 2026-12-03. Owner: Ben Carter.

Immediate asks: FastOEM — can you mark the first tranche week-of date in the attached proposed_schedule_staggered.xlsx and indicate deposit % required to book BOM? Orbit — confirm the reservation fee amount and draft addendum link.

Links: HubSpot deal record: https://hubspot.example.com/deals/ACME-D-9981
DocuSign: https://www.docusign.com/links/ACME-D-9981-commit

Attachments: proposed_schedule_staggered.xlsx, OEM_Quote_FastOEM_v2.pdf, OrbitCloud_capacity_offer.xlsx

I'll coordinate the legal addendum but we need vendor timelines fast so ACME procurement can proceed.

Thanks,
Markus Klein
Head of Capacity Planning | Redwood Inference
